subject: Request: APAC geozone pricing carveout — VP/CFO sign-off needed
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@senzahealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@senzahealth.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 15:14:00 -0700
Subject: APAC pricing ask & usage forecast (Senza Health)

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the regional routing options. We are getting ready to expand our footprint across APAC and have some constraints from local procurement and our finance team around currency exposure and unit economics when serving from non-local regions.

High-level ask: Senza wants a regional pricing carveout for APAC traffic where we commit to a 12-month minimum spend (estimated $600k USD) in exchange for a blended discount to hosted API list rates. We can also lock a cap on outbound egress if that helps structure the deal.

I attached a usage forecast (senza_usage_forecast_q2_q4.xlsx) with month-by-month token estimates. Can Redwood provide a short internal memo and approval routing we can review with our procurement? We want to avoid a long RFP cycle.

If helpful, we can jump on a quick call — procurement (copied) is available next week.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Manager — Senza Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@senzahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@senzahealth.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC pricing ask & usage forecast (Senza Health)

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the forecast and context. We can support a regional carveout but will need internal sign-off from finance and our commercial VP for the requested blended rate and the commitment structure. I’ve pulled the forecast and sketched two options:

- Option A (Commitment + Tiered Discount): 12-month $600k commit, blended 28% off hosted list for APAC traffic with a usage true-up quarterly.
- Option B (Commitment + Usage Floors): 12-month $600k commit, 22% off hosted list + 10% credit pool for burst months; requires minimum monthly floor at 70% of forecast.

Both options assume Redwood will route APAC traffic to our Singapore region endpoints and provide standard data handling assurances. I’ll prepare a concise memo for VP/CFO sign-off and loop in finance (Marissa).

Can you confirm whether the commitment is company-wide or limited to a single Senza BU? That impacts how we model revenue recognition.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: APAC pricing ask & usage forecast (Senza Health)

Mina / Markus —

I reviewed the forecast and Mina’s two-option structure. A few notes before I can recommend financial approval to Laura:

1) Revenue recognition: If Senza’s commitment is company-wide we should treat as a multi-element ARR anchor; need legal to confirm cancellation terms.
2) FX exposure: Senza expects billing in USD, but they have APAC subsidiaries. If billing stays USD we should model a 3–5% churn risk due to FX.
3) Margin sensitivity: At 28% blended discount the per-token margin in our Singapore cluster drops ~9 percentage points assuming current quantized runtime. Need to confirm whether we can apply moderate quantization profile for this workload to keep margins acceptable.

Please attach the term sheet draft and a one-page summary with net present value at 12 months (after discounts). If you can, add a short fallback clause: automatic tiered rollback to baseline rates if usage drops below 50% of forecast for two consecutive quarters.

I’m available for a 30-min sync Monday afternoon to go over the numbers.

-Marissa
Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Apr 2027 15:33:00 -0700
Subject: Internal memo: Recommendation for Senza Health APAC carveout (requesting VP/CFO sign-off)

Markus / Laura —

Summary: Senza Health (RDW-3421) requests a 12-month, $600k commit to support APAC expansion in exchange for a regional blend between 22–28% off hosted list for APAC traffic. My recommendation is to approve Option B (22% + 10% burst credits + 70% monthly floor) with the following guardrails:

Why Option B?
- Preserves margin: lower blended discount reduces margin erosion while providing operational flexibility.
- Protects against low utilization: monthly floor and two-quarter rollback clause guard against long tail usage risk.
- Simpler billing: charge in USD with explicit FX risk note in contract.

Key commercial terms (proposed):
- Term: 12 months starting from first invoice.
- Commitment: $600k USD, invoiced quarterly in arrears with true-up.
- APAC carveout: Applies only to traffic routed to APAC endpoints and billed under the Senza primary account.
- Discount: 22% off hosted list for covered traffic.
- Burst credit: 10% of committed amount reserved for overage months; credits exhaust before invoice reductions.
- Usage floor: minimum monthly usage = 70% forecast; if below 50% for two consecutive quarters, rates rollback to baseline list for remainder of term.
- Data & compliance: Redwood to provide region-specific SOC 2 attestation and standard DPA controls (no changes).

Financial impact (high level):
- NPV @ 12 months (conservative): ~$530k (after discount, excludes deduped credits).
- Expected margin compression limited to ~4–6% compared to baseline when quantization optimizations are applied.

Attachments: term sheet draft and the Senza forecast (senza_usage_forecast_q2_q4.xlsx).

Ask: Laura — please sign off (or provide edits) on the commercial guardrails and approval to send the term-sheet to Senza. Markus — if you agree, please confirm final commercial approval. Marissa — thanks for the modeling; if you need any adjustments I can update the memo.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 11 Apr 2027 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal memo: Recommendation for Senza Health APAC carveout (requesting VP/CFO sign-off)

Thanks Mina — I reviewed and agree with Option B and the guardrails. Laura — I recommend we sign off conditionally:

- Approve Option B with the two-quarter rollback clause and the 70% floor.
- Legal to include explicit cancellation language limiting early termination credits to the remaining committed balance pro rata.
- Finance to confirm NPV and ensure the revenue schedule is set to quarterly true-ups.

If Laura confirms, Mina please send the term-sheet (redwood-apac-carveout-term-sheet-v1.pdf) to Alicia with the note that this is VP/CFO approved subject to legal finalization.

-Markus
VP, Commercial — Redwood Inference
